# Pearlescent & opal

A pale, glowing sheen that shifts hue as the surface turns away and varies from flake to flake, like pearl, opal or pearlescent car paint.

<EffectDemo effect="pearlescent" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { pearlescent } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/pearlescent';

const effect = pearlescent({ preset: 'pearl' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.sheen = 0.8`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter        | Type    | Default | Range    | Description                                                             |
| ---------------- | ------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `sheen`          | number  | `0.8`   | 0 – 3    | Brightness of the sheen.                                                |
| `hueRange`       | number  | `0.6`   | 0 – 2    | How far the hue travels from the center to the rim, in turns.           |
| `hueOffset`      | number  | `0.55`  | 0 – 1    | Hue facing the camera, in turns.                                        |
| `saturation`     | number  | `0.45`  | 0 – 1    | Color strength; pearl is pale, opal is vivid.                           |
| `flakeScale`     | number  | `0.15`  | 0.01 – 1 | Size of the flakes, in object units.                                    |
| `flakeVariation` | number  | `0.3`   | 0 – 1    | How much the hue varies between flakes.                                 |
| `tintBase`       | number  | `0.3`   | 0 – 1    | How much the hue also colors the surface itself.                        |
| `seed`           | integer | `0`     | 0 – 9999 | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                                                       |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `pearl`    | `saturation: 0.25`, `sheen: 0.6`, `flakeVariation: 0.1`                        |
| `opal`     | `saturation: 0.85`, `hueRange: 1.2`, `flakeVariation: 0.8`, `flakeScale: 0.06` |
| `carPaint` | `saturation: 0.6`, `flakeScale: 0.02`, `sheen: 1.2`                            |
| `abalone`  | `saturation: 0.7`, `hueOffset: 0.4`, `hueRange: 1.5`                           |

Apply one with `pearlescent({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X11.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 6.6 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/pearlescent`, including the shared effect runtime.
